description: Fetch a public or authenticated URL as readable Markdown, with source, retrieval time, content hash and completeness. Specialized handlers support GitHub, Wikipedia, YouTube transcripts, PDFs, arXiv and tweets. Otherwise checks fresh shared content, then native Markdown/direct HTML, hosted rendering, and labeled archive fallbacks. Authenticated requests use direct sources only. Paginate long pages with startIndex and maxLength. noCache forces retrieval and disables archives unless explicitly allowed.

allowArchive.description: Allow labeled historical snapshots after live retrieval fails; disabled by noCache unless explicitly enabled

maxAgeSeconds.description: Oldest acceptable cached retrieval in seconds; 0 forces retrieval (default 3600)

maxTier.description: Stop at this tier (1-5, default 5). Lower = faster but fewer fallbacks.

noCache.description: Skip session and shared caches and fetch live content

startIndex.description: Character offset to start from, for paginating long content (default 0)

timeoutMs.description: Overall retrieval deadline in milliseconds, including downloads (default 25000)

name: fetch

bytes.description: Image size in bytes, when an image was returned

cacheAgeSeconds.description: Age of the content when served from the shared cache

contentLength.description: Full length of the fetched content in characters

mimeType.description: Set when the URL is an image returned as an image block

nextStartIndex.description: Pass as startIndex to fetch the next chunk

title: Fetch URL
